---
description: Check scientific accuracy, native footage, timing and completeness of a Remotion automotive explainer.
---

Review the actual source composition, shot timing, original technical references, model hierarchy, approved narration, rendered stills and native moving clip. Run pipeline preflight, full decoder and relevant telemetry checks. Record each verified problem with scene and frame numbers, a mechanical explanation, and a proposed fix. A test passing is not sufficient for approval. Never claim a visual inspection if you have access only to text metadata.
